item.title: ISA Legal And Technical Commission Concludes First Part Of 31st Session - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: The International Seabed Authority (ISA) has concluded the first part of the work of the Legal and Technical Commission (LTC).

item.title: BOEM Advances Next Steps For Potential Outer Continental Shelf Mineral Leasing Offshore The Commonwealth Of The Northern Mariana Islands - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: BOEM announced the completion of the Area Identification step in BOEM’s Outer Continental Shelf mineral leasing process for potential critical mineral development offshore the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.

item.title: Deep Sea Minerals Corp. Submits Application To NOAA Under Deep Seabed Hard Mineral Resources Act - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: Deep Sea Minerals Corp. (Deep Sea Minerals) has announced that it has submitted an application to the US National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) pursuant to the Deep Seabed Hard Mineral Resources Act (DSHMRA).

item.title: Deep Sea Minerals Corp. Submits Response To US Defense Industrial Base Consortium Solicitation For Critical Minerals - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: Deep Sea Minerals announced that it has submitted its bid in response to a solicitation from the US Defense Industrial Base Consortium (DIBC) to provide to the United States a reliable supply of critical minerals, focusing on Nickel.

item.title: The Permanent Representative Of The Commonwealth Of The Bahamas Presents Credentials To The ISA - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: Her Excellency Mrs. Alveta Adderley-Knight presented her credentials to the Secretary-General of the International Seabed Authority (ISA), Ms. Leticia Carvalho, as Permanent Representative of the Commonwealth of The Bahamas to the International Seabed Authority.

item.title: NOAA Ship To Map Potential Critical Mineral Deposits In US Waters Of Pacific Ocean - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: In early April, the NOAA Ship Rainier will begin to map and characterize more than 8,000 square nautical miles of federal waters off Kingman Reef and Palmyra Atoll in the Pacific Ocean.

item.title: Glomar Minerals And Cobalt Blue Launch Seabed Mineral Processing Consortium - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: Glomar Minerals, LLC (Glomar Minerals) and Cobalt Blue Holdings Limited (Cobalt Blue) announced a consortium agreement to process seabed minerals in the United States (US).

item.title: GSR Signs MOU With Japan’s DORD To Conduct Joint Demonstration Test In The CCZ - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: Global Sea Mineral Resources (GSR) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with Deep Ocean Resources Development Co., Ltd. (DORD) of Japan to conduct a joint demonstration test aimed at the potential co-development of polymetallic nodule resources.

item.title: Twenty-Four New Deep-Sea Species Discovered In Major Pacific Research - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: Describing the species encountered during these studies is a critical step in documenting the rich biodiversity of the CCZ.

item.title: The Council Of The International Seabed Authority Advances Negotiations On The Mining Code - Ocean Mining Intel
item.description: The Council of the International Seabed Authority (ISA) has concluded Part I of its 31st Session, held in Kingston, Jamaica.
